from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem, rdMolDescriptors
import numpy as np
names=['A','B','C','D','E','F','OketD','MeA1','MeA2','Oether','G','H','L','OketL','I','MeI','M','N','Q','P','J','Olac','K','OketK']
elements=['C']*24
for i in [6,9,13,21,23]: elements[i]='O'
m=Chem.RWMol()
for e in elements:m.AddAtom(Chem.Atom(e))
bonds=[(0,1,1),(1,2,2),(2,3,1),(3,4,1),(4,5,1),(5,0,1),(3,6,2),(0,7,1),(0,8,1),(5,9,1),(9,10,1),(4,11,1),(4,20,1),(20,21,1),(21,22,1),(22,10,1),(22,23,2),(10,11,1),(11,12,1),(12,13,2),(12,14,1),(14,16,1),(14,15,1),(16,17,1),(17,10,1),(11,18,1),(18,19,1),(19,16,1)]
for i,j,b in bonds:m.AddBond(i,j,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE if b==2 else Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
m=m.GetMol();Chem.SanitizeMol(m)
print(Chem.MolToSmiles(m));print(rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(m));print(Chem.FindMolChiralCenters(m,includeUnassigned=True))
for i,a in enumerate(m.GetAtoms()):print(i,names[i],a.GetSymbol(),a.GetTotalNumHs(),[v.GetIdx() for v in a.GetNeighbors()])

import numpy as np
from rdkit import Chem
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
import matplotlib;matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
m=Chem.MolFromMolFile('rough_opt.mol',removeHs=False)
names=['A','B','C','D','E','F','OketD','MeA1','MeA2','Oether','G','H','L','OketL','I','MeI','M','N','Q','P','J','Olac','K','OketK']
xy=np.array([(224,266),(164,164),(280,131),(396,164),(456,266),(339,235),(480,82),(98,232),(224,395),(375,326),(491,348),(576,265),(606,148),(548,49),(716,148),(808,78),(686,266),(612,348),(686,324),(815,324),(424,384),(336,469),(456,466),(527,565)],float)
xy[:,1]*=-1;xy=(xy-xy.mean(axis=0))/100
coords=m.GetConformer().GetPositions();coords-=coords[:24].mean(axis=0)
wt=np.ones(24); wt[[6,7,8,9,13,15,21,23]]=0.75

def err(v):
 R=Rotation.from_rotvec(v[:3]).as_matrix()
 p=coords[:24]@R.T
 return ((v[3]*p[:,:2]+v[4:6]-xy)*wt[:,None]).ravel()
res=[]
for i in range(40):
 v0=[*Rotation.random().as_rotvec(),0.8,0,0]
 opt=least_squares(err,v0,max_nfev=700)
 if opt.x[3]>0:res.append(opt)
opt=min(res,key=lambda r:np.sum(r.fun**2)); print('cost',np.sum(opt.fun**2))
R=Rotation.from_rotvec(opt.x[:3]).as_matrix();xyz=coords@R.T
np.save('aligned.npy',xyz)
print([(names[i],list(np.round(xyz[i],2))) for i in range(24)])
plt.figure(figsize=(12,8));ax=plt.gca();ax.set_aspect('equal')
for b in sorted(m.GetBonds(),key=lambda b:xyz[[b.GetBeginAtomIdx(),b.GetEndAtomIdx()],2].mean()):
 i,j=b.GetBeginAtomIdx(),b.GetEndAtomIdx()
 if i>=24 or j>=24:continue
 p,q=xyz[i],xyz[j]
 ax.plot([p[0],q[0]],[p[1],q[1]],color='k',linewidth=2+1.0*(p[2]+q[2]+4),zorder=1)
 if b.GetBondType()==Chem.BondType.DOUBLE:
  d=q[:2]-p[:2];off=np.array([-d[1],d[0]])/np.linalg.norm(d)*.10
  ax.plot([p[0]+off[0],q[0]+off[0]],[p[1]+off[1],q[1]+off[1]],color='k',linewidth=2,zorder=1)
for i,p in enumerate(xyz[:24]):
 ax.text(*p[:2],names[i]+'\n'+str(round(p[2],1)),ha='center',va='center',fontsize=10,bbox={'facecolor':'white','edgecolor':'none','alpha':0.9},zorder=5)
plt.savefig('fit.png',dpi=140)
Chem.MolToXYZFile(m,'initial.xyz')

python - <<'PY'
import numpy as np
from collections import Counter
lines=open('xtb_run/xtbopt.xyz').read().splitlines()
symbols=[l.split()[0] for l in lines[2:]]
xyz=np.array([[float(v) for v in l.split()[1:4]] for l in lines[2:]])
target=np.load('aligned.npy')
xyz-=xyz[:24].mean(axis=0)
target-=target[:24].mean(axis=0)
u,s,vt=np.linalg.svd(xyz[:24].T@target[:24]); corr=np.eye(3);corr[2,2]=np.linalg.det(u@vt)
r=u@corr@vt
assert np.linalg.det(r)>0.999999
xyz=xyz@r
with open('answer.xyz','w') as f:
 f.write(f'{len(symbols)}\nC19H22O5; geometry optimized with GFN2-xTB; coordinates in angstroms\n')
 for e,p in zip(symbols,xyz):f.write(f'{e:2s} {p[0]: .8f} {p[1]: .8f} {p[2]: .8f}\n')
assert len(symbols)==46 and Counter(symbols)=={'C':19,'O':5,'H':22}
print('answer.xyz exists; 46 atoms (C19H22O5), including 22 explicit hydrogens.')
